trigger: PR19A routing revealed critical TPSM33625 support components were packed by generic PR17 placement rather than by TI electrical proximity priorities

authority.primary_source: TI TPSM33625 datasheet SNVSCB1D Rev. D, section 8.5.1 Layout Guidelines

ti_layout_intent: Place input capacitors as close as possible to VIN and GND.
Place the VCC bypass capacitor close to VCC and route VCC/GND with short wide traces.
Place R_FBT and R_FBB as close as possible to FB; FB and GND connections must be short.
Do not solve a poor micro-placement by relaxing DRC or by adding arbitrary layer changes.

C_5V_IN_4U7.role: VIN bulk ceramic adjacent to U_5V island; VIN pad faces module

C_5V_IN_100N.role: high-frequency VIN bypass closest to U_5V VIN side; VIN pad faces module

R_5V_FBT.role: feedback top resistor vertical below FB edge

R_5V_FBB.role: feedback bottom resistor vertical below FB/GND edge

C_5V_VCC.role: VCC bypass immediately below VCC/GND edge

routing_restart: After this ECO is merged, restart PR19A from clean main and require 28/28 under routing_batches_contract.json.
